transcript: After helping thousands of people, I realized people who show the most love never felt loved themselves. So they end up caring for others more than themselves, hoping they would receive it back. But they never do. They always hide their pain, telling everyone only half the story, and hiding it all from their parents, because they don't want to be a burden. This is what thousands of people taught me, that being overly empathetic isn't kindness, it's self-abandonment, and I wish someone had told them that sooner. If this is you, I put together a 30-day healing journey in the link on my profile. Not to fix you, you were never broken, but to bring you back to yourself.
